name: MRDIY
recent: 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，另有 COO 在公开市场购入 40,000 股。新闻焦点集中在 Pinduoduo 竞争压力下股价跌至 2020 年以来低位，但多数分析员仍维持原有评级。最新季度营收同比增 3.6%，净利同比降 15.2%。
notable: 公司 COO Gan Sau Liang 于 2026 年 10 月 12 日在公开市场购入 40,000 股普通股。
EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间连续多日申报股东权益变动。
媒体报道 Pinduoduo 竞争压力下公司股价跌至 2020 年以来最低水平。
risks: 媒体报道 Pinduoduo 带来的零售竞争压力。
最新季度净利同比下滑 15.2%，净利率由 14.0% 降至 10.7%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 12.573 亿令吉，同比增 3.6%，环比降 8.5%；净利 1.344 亿令吉，同比降 15.2%，环比降 30.0%；净利率 10.7%，低于上期的 14.0%。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly EPF substantial shareholder changes, plus the COO acquiring 40,000 shares in the open market. News focus is on share price hitting its lowest since 2020 amid Pinduoduo competition, though most analysts maintained their calls. Latest quarter revenue rose 3.6% YoY while net profit fell 15.2% YoY.
notable_en: COO Gan Sau Liang acquired 40,000 ordinary shares in the open market on 12 Oct 2026.
EPF filed substantial shareholder changes on multiple consecutive days from October to November.
Media reported the share price fell to its lowest since 2020 amid Pinduoduo competition.
risks_en: Media reported retail competition pressure from Pinduoduo.
Latest quarter net profit fell 15.2% YoY, with net margin down from 14.0% to 10.7%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was MYR1,257.3m, up 3.6% YoY and down 8.5% QoQ; net profit was MYR134.4m, down 15.2% YoY and 30.0% QoQ; net margin was 10.7% versus 14.0% previously.
